description: Search and filter disc golf discs by text query, brand, category, speed/glide range, stability score range, flight tag, and canonical flight class. Returns up to 50 bounded results with stable IDs and canonical URLs.

category.description: Filter by disc category (putter, midrange, fairway_driver, distance_driver)

is_ranked.description: If true, only return discs currently holding a global Top 100 sales ranking

limit.description: Maximum number of discs to return (1..50, default 10)

query.description: Text query to match disc name, brand, model, or slug

tag.description: Filter by flight tag (e.g. 'Lockdown Fade', 'True Flight', 'Progressive Turn', 'Early Turn', 'Assured Fade')

name: search_discs
